tissue_caption: Occupancy taken from a measured human prostate section (10x Xenium): glands pack, lumens stay empty. ~5.0 neighbours per cell, which is the honest figure. The default.
patient_headline: Patient SC_9184_T — 36 missense mutations on 6 HLA class-I alleles
caveats: HLA typing method is 'population-default', which is not derived from this patient's reads. The NK licensing model refuses an unmeasured typing on purpose.
18 coding variants cannot cross over (nonsense, frameshift, synonymous, or a wild-type residue that does not match the reference). Each is listed with its reason.

The biopsy is a LIVER METASTASIS, not prostate tissue. The run lays these cells out on a measured prostate section, so the genome is this patient's and the tissue architecture is not. Choosing a different layout would not fix it -- no measured liver-metastasis geometry is in this repository.

Coordinates are GRCh37 and protein changes come from the source MAF's own HGVSp_Short, not re-annotated here. Three coding variants are skipped because the reference proteome disagrees with the source at that residue, which is the transcript difference surfacing rather than being hidden.

The somatic calls are the consortium's: the source publishes Mutation_Status against a matched normal but publishes no normal read counts, so the VCF's normal genotype asserts their finding rather than carrying evidence of our own.

This patient had already received abiraterone/enzalutamide and a taxane (cabazitaxel). Any treatment the simulator applies is therefore being added to a history the model does not represent, not given to an untreated man.

TMB is reported against a default 30 Mb exome because the study does not publish its capture footprint. The study's own nonsynonymous density is 1.8; agreement with ours is not independent confirmation if both divide by a similar number.

notes: Enzalutamide is an AGONIST on AR F877L, and that variant is in 10% of the founding cancer cells, not all of them. Those cells are driven at 3.05x the untreated baseline (Balbas 2013 PMID 23580326 (eLife, open access), AR-dependent EGFP reporter: F876L + enzalutamide 1051 vs vehicle 345 = 3.05x baseline, 62% of the DHT maximum (partial agonist)); every other cell has the wild-type receptor and is blocked as the drug class says
